BD_STATUS,Board not in position,"(1) The subcard is physically present but is not registered
(2) The board is offline
(3) The fan is not in position
(4) The control board is physically present but is not registered
(5) The chassis has insufficient board resources for the inserted subcard
(6) The active and standby control boards have different hardware types."
BEFFEC_EXC,Pre-FEC error count above threshold,"1. The optical-port input power is too high or too low.
2. The fiber is bent excessively.
3. The fiber connector is contaminated.
4. The optical module is not firmly inserted or is faulty.
5. The interconnected boards use inconsistent FEC modes.
6. The board reporting the alarm is faulty.
7. The board at the remote end is faulty."
IN_PWR_LOW,Low input optical power,"(1) The transmit power at the remote site is too low
(2) Fiber performance has degraded
(3) An unsuitable optical-module type is used
(4) The fiber connector is contaminated
(5) The patch cord is excessively bent, damaged, or aged
(6) Excessive attenuation is applied to the receive port of the local board
(7) The optical signal suffers excessive transmission loss without sufficient optical-amplifier compensation
(8) Excessive attenuation is applied to the transmit port of the remote board, or its transmit optical module is faulty, resulting in low transmit power
(9) The local board is faulty
(10) An upstream fiber cut causes the received signal to contain only noise
(11) The laser on an upstream board is disabled, causing the received signal to contain only noise."
MUT_LOS,Loss of multiplexed signal,"(1) The fiber connected to the board is disconnected or damaged
(2) The signal suffers excessive transmission loss
(3) The board is faulty."
MUT_TLOS,Loss of transmit optical power at the multiplexed optical port,The alarm is raised when the output optical power of the multiplexed optical port falls below the configured lower threshold.
ODUCN_PM_LCK,ODUCn PM signal lock defect,The signal is locked while the current line signal is being tested.
OLP_PS,Optical line protection switching,This alarm is reported when an optical line protection group switches the working channel from the primary channel to the standby channel.
OLP_STA_INDI,Optical line protection group status indication,"(1) An SF or SD condition exists on the primary or standby channel of the protection group.
(2) The protection group is in an externally commanded switching state."
OSC_LOS,Loss of input optical power on the OSC board,The input optical power of the OSC board is below its LOS threshold.
OTUCN_LOF,OTUCn loss of frame,"The board reporting the alarm is faulty
The receive optical power or signal-to-noise ratio on the local board is abnormal
The corresponding board at the remote end transmits a signal without a frame structure
The fiber transmission line is abnormal
Chromatic-dispersion compensation is too high or too low
In the C+L system, dummy light is inserted, preventing the OTU board from receiving the optical signal
The service type or FEC type does not match
The line coding formats at the two ends do not match."

POWER_DIFF_OVER,Optical-power difference between primary and standby channels above threshold,"(1) Excessive attenuation on the primary or standby channel causes the received optical-power difference to exceed the 5 dB threshold
(2) A large transmit-power difference between the primary and standby channels at the upstream site causes the received optical-power difference to exceed the 5 dB threshold
(3) The monitoring circuit on the board is faulty."
R_LOS,Loss of receive line-side signal,"(1) No patch cord is connected to the optical interface of the local board
(2) The laser on the remote board is disabled
(3) The transmission fiber is cut
(4) Transmission-line attenuation is excessive
(5) The transmit section of the remote board is faulty
(6) The receive section of the local board is faulty."
SUM_INPWR_LOW,Low aggregate input optical power,"(1) The external input optical power is too low
(2) The analog-to-digital converter reports an abnormal measurement."
